disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: select_gear_v2 parses nonessential pressure telemetry before calling v1, so malformed context/tool/stale/anchor/progress/storage telemetry can prevent authenticated rollback/standby from ever producing R/N. After v1 returns R/N, v2 recovery_active, anchor<0.50 or RED secretary can still overwrite that terminal result with G1. Terminal authority is therefore not structurally dominant across v1->v2->v2.1.
disagreements.required_change: Authenticate terminal authority before nonessential telemetry. Trusted rollback R must be terminal and non-overridable by secretary/pressure/recovery overlays; standby N may exit only through an explicit trusted higher-priority authority rule. Add a canonical N/R/G1..G6 control-state transition contract and terminal-exit receipt.

statistical_risks: Terminal rollback/standby outcomes can be censored by telemetry parse failures or overwritten by overlays, biasing safety and recovery statistics.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics require matched paired/crossover evaluation with a frozen versioned metric manifest.
proposed_tests: GB21-TERMINAL-PRECEDENCE-187: rollback_required=true with malformed pressure telemetry must still reach authenticated R or an explicitly stronger terminal fail-closed result.
GB21-TERMINAL-OVERLAY-188: authenticated R plus recovery_active/anchor failure/RED secretary must remain R; nonterminal overlays cannot rewrite rollback.
GB21-STANDBY-EXIT-AUTHORITY-189: N may leave standby only through an explicit trusted terminal-exit authority rule.
GB21-INHERITED-SAFETY-METADATA-190: v2 checkpoint/ACK/verification constraints must survive v2.1 projection or exact inherited-decision fingerprint verification.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE: stale RED/ORANGE plus forged freshness=true and stale numeric pressure must not route without a trusted provenance envelope.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION: fresh authority=G1/recovery with permissive caller fallback must still produce the trusted authority result.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-SMALL-N: 1/1 and 2/3 samples must not trigger calibrated anti-thrash without precommitted minimum support.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERF-NR: lower shift rate is rejected as improvement if cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency regresses.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-NULL: forged high verified_progress_density must remain observational and cannot upshift or create credit.
GB21-EVENT-LINEAGE-REPLAY: same evidence under 10000 new IDs plus exact-ID restart/rollback replay must produce one authoritative acceptance only.
GB21-VERIFIED-RECEIPT-BINDING: verified event without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt yields zero authoritative verified Experience.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-RECEIPT-BINDING: raw DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND IDs without durable artifact/defect receipt yield zero authoritative operational credit.
GB21-CREDIT-NON-EQUIVALENCE: equal aggregate heuristic scores from different event mixtures must not be treated as equal capability or promotion evidence.

GB21-SPEED-PAIRED-BASELINE: sealed matched AB/BA or randomized crossover uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest and assigned-workload coverage.

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

Authenticated terminal authority is evaluated before nonessential telemetry; rollback R is structurally terminal and cannot be overwritten by secretary/pressure/recovery overlays; N exit requires explicit trusted authority.
v2.1 preserves all safety-critical inherited v2 metadata or binds an immutable exact inherited-decision fingerprint/reference.
Secretary signal provenance/freshness is replay-resistant and fresh authority is projected from an exact trusted authority decision.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted denominator/sample/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; paired performance non-regression passes.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independent derivation and anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

Accepted event identity and evidence lineage are durable and rollback-resistant; exact replay NO_OPs, same evidence/new ID cannot re-credit, same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT, and rejected claims do not reserve identity.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw fields.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND require durable artifact/defect acceptance receipts and lineage dedupe for authoritative operational credit while remaining non-Experience.
5/4/3/1 credit values remain heuristic/analytics-only and are never capability, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance or promotion truth.

A sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover speed study uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with frozen metric manifest and equal assigned workload/exposure/censoring plus verification/risk non-regression.
Quantum and dedicated Spirit reviews plus fresh Navigator synthesis have zero unresolved adoption-blocking vetoes before any normal A->B->C route is considered.
